standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings, adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.

options.condition: If the player is not in the process of completing Dragon Slayer II:

steps.npc: The Myths' Guild is home to those who wish to uncover the lost secrets of this world. We investigate the myths of these lands to see if any facts may be hidden within them.
Here, we discover things that others only dream of. However, the cost of entry is not insignificant. Only the most worthy may share in our secrets.

steps.text: If the player has not started Dragon Slayer II:

steps.npc: Not yet. However, that could well change.
For as long as history remembers, dragons have roamed these lands, but despite how long they've been here, much of their history remains hidden.
There are tales of course, but tales are not enough for us. We want you to discover the truth. Where did the dragons come from? Why are they here? Who do they serve?
Answer these questions for us. Help us fill our Library of Knowledge. In return, we will grant you access to the guild and you will reap the rewards within.
So, do you feel up for the challenge?

steps.prompt: Start the Dragon Slayer II quest?

steps.npc: Head to Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers at Musa Point. There you'll find Dallas Jones. We've heard that he is investigating the destruction of Crandor. This seems like a good place to start.
Good luck.

steps.text: If the player has finished Dragon Slayer II:

options.text: How can I gain access to the guild?
options.condition: If the player has not started Dragon Slayer II:

steps.player: How can I gain access to the guild?

steps.npc: Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you wish to enter, you'll need to prove yourself.
As time passes, that which was once fact, becomes myth. Some tales are just that, tales. However, some tales are something more.
Here at the Myths' Guild, we live to tell the difference between the two. If you wish to join us, you must do the same.

steps.player: So what myth would you like me to investigate?

steps.text: Continues above from "For as long as history remembers"

options.condition: If the player has partially completed Dragon Slayer II:

steps.npc: How are things progressing?

steps.text: If the player has not yet discovered anything:

steps.npc: Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.

steps.text: If the player has been to Lithkren but not opened the doors:
